criteria.requirement: Resolve existing typed identities and expose ambiguity; keep roles distinct from session instances.
Separate modality, standing, currency, enforcement and attribution.
Explain every formalization with source, assumptions, scope and independently reviewable pattern standing.
On semantic input revision, compute complete transitive invalidation along declared dependency edges, without automatically changing acceptance.
No broad invalidation through mere topic anchors, layouts or unrelated data.
Return all affected IDs and dependency paths, with bounded rendering/pagination if needed; never confuse a truncated response with a complete set.
Compute readiness independently of answers; name all mandatory blockers, including retired/withdrawn prerequisites.
Resolve questions according to answer shape and coverage, with transparent totals and stale-answer handling.

Report structural gaps with severity/context: orphan anchors, ungoverned operations, unanchored claims, edgeless questions and invalid revision cycles. Placeholder incompleteness is not logical inconsistency.
Compare supported authority patterns using declared role/scope/modality semantics, with a witness or explicit unknown.
Compare supported cardinality patterns using interval intersection, identity, scope and existence assumptions.
Keep formal unsupported results, incomplete evidence and bounded absence of counterexamples distinct.
Evaluate concrete traces at event time and cite exact witnesses; don't change beliefs or case labels automatically.
Invalidate saved results when any semantic input, extraction assumption, referenced definition or checker changes.
Retrieve current positions, superseded alternatives and their rationale without conflating them.
Make a recorded potential tension inspectable; never present LLM semantic judgment as deterministic proof.
Surface Morphisms responsibility gaps without pre-deciding unresolved policy.
Preserve atomic audited writes, references and optimistic concurrency across failure/retry.
Return compact bounded text and valid structured JSON; aliases/flags/help are sufficient for agent use.
Deterministic findings include exact node/edge/version witnesses and explicit check scope.
Respect source trust boundaries and the user's requested pace.
Demonstrate semantic recovery versus an equivalent prose baseline, measuring maintenance cost too.

scope: Explicit contract-to-case mapping; additional gap checks must also pass for AC09.
